inferences.reference: Cholesterol is an animal sterol; vegetable oils carry phytosterols and no cholesterol. USDA SR Legacy 171413 'Oil, olive, salad or cooking' reports cholesterol 0 mg/100 g; the Foundation record 748608 'Oil, olive, extra virgin' has no cholesterol row at all (field absent, not zero). Scope: records whose description starts 'Oil, olive' and lines that name olive oil.
